rationale: GAD1/GAD3/GAD5/GAD6 pins (M37 #599), authored from probe-verified emission. GAD1 (JAD2 contract): field reads attribute to the enclosing METHOD (cap->limit), never the receiver variable. GAD3: visibility is AST-only — leak() contains the literal 'this is private data' and must stay public. GAD6: keyword modifiers are ANONYMOUS children — hidden()=private, guard()=protected must survive. GAD5: public String greet() keeps its return_type ref (modifiers no longer terminate the type scan).
